svg.title: checkpoint-chain-four-robots-theta-labels-spring-arrows-to-finetuned-copies
svg.desc: row of four cartoon robots (bitmap) joined left to right by dotted and solid arrows, a theta label under each (theta_0, theta_t, theta_t+1, theta_T), and above each a grey coiled spring arrow up to its simulated-finetuned copy that turns from blue to pale red to red, a thin dotted divider between the two rows | source: iclr26-0140_fig1 (iclr26-0140_fig1_p2_mixed.svg) | candidate wave1:checkpoint-chain-four-robots-theta-labels-spring-arrows-to-finetuned-copies | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
